title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity bump v1.167.0
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: SDKs across Python/TypeScript/Go have drifted in small but user-visible ways around auth handling, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics. This PR consolidates the compatibility surface so that: 1) auth token refresh and header precedence are consistent across SDKs; 2) default retry/backoff behavior matches platform expectations (3 retries, exponential backoff, idempotency-aware where applicable); 3) streaming APIs expose a consistent ergonomic interface (unified event types, easier cancellation, consistent error propagation). Also includes a parity/version bump to v1.167.0 for release. What this changes (high level): - Canonicalize auth header precedence: explicit auth param > env var > config file for all SDKs. Added integration tests and docs. - Centralize retry policy definition in the TypeScript SDK and propagate consistent semantics to Python and Go wrappers. Default: 3 retries, initial_backoff=200ms, max_backoff=2s, jitter=true. - Streaming ergonomics: move to a small event enum (open|message|complete|error|heartbeat) and provide a standardized iterator/async iterator helper in each SDK. Cancellation token semantics unified to cancel the underlying HTTP/transport and surface a CancelledError. - Backward-compatible helpers: added convenience overloads and helper constructors to retain previous call sites. - Minor docs updates and a version bump to v1.167.0 across SDK manifests. Testing/CI: added unit tests for header precedence, retry counters, and streaming cancellation. Integration test against a local mock server (streaming replay) included. Notes: Kept changes small in each repository package to reduce release risk; most logic was added to the TypeScript reference implementation and ported to Python/Go with language-idiomatic wrappers. Related: Linear ENG-4251, SDK-193. Checklist: [x] Update TypeScript reference implementation [x] Port behavior to Python SDK [x] Port behavior to Go SDK [x] Update docs and changelogs [x] Add unit/integration tests [x] Bump SDK versions to v1.167.0 Merge plan: squash-and-merge after all approvals and CI green.
